If you need a porta cabin in Tumkur and you need it in less than a week, there is one fact that matters above everything else: our factory is 65 kilometres from your site.

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd manufactures MS-frame steel porta cabins at Gopasandra, Bangalore (560099). Tumkur (officially Tumakuru) sits on NH 48 â€” the Bangaloreâ€“Mumbai national highway â€” and is the closest major industrial city to our factory after Hosur. Transit from our gate to a KIADB Hirehalli plot is typically one day of road time. That means a standard cabin ordered today can be dispatched within 7 to 10 working days of manufacture and delivered to your Tumkur address within a day or two after that. No other South India manufacturer can put a factory-certified MS cabin on your Tumkur site faster from a comparable distance.

We are the manufacturer â€” ISO-certified, NSIC-registered, building prefab steel structures since 2009. Browse porta cabins we manufacture or call directly with your requirement.

Tumkurâ€™s Industrial Character and Why Porta Cabins Are in Demand Here

Tumkur is not a peripheral city that happens to be near Bangalore. It is a city with its own industrial identity â€” and that identity is growing fast because of a specific combination: land availability, NH 48 access, and proximity to Bangalore without Bangaloreâ€™s land prices.

KIADB Hirehalli Industrial Area (PIN 572168): The primary KIADB zone in Tumkur, Hirehalli hosts precision engineering firms, auto component suppliers, and electronics assembly units. Companies like Kirloskar Electric and TVS-related suppliers have had a presence here for years. New unit construction and expansion at Hirehalli is ongoing â€” and every construction site needs a site office, every factory entry needs a security cabin, every material yard needs a lockable store room.

Antharasanahalli Industrial Area (PIN 572106): The newer phase of Tumkurâ€™s KIADB expansion, Antharasanahalli hosts a broader mix including springs and stampings manufacturers, food processing units, and mid-sized engineering firms. The zone is actively developing, which means active construction â€” which means active demand for site offices.

HMT legacy and the Tumkur engineering culture: HMTâ€™s watch factory operated from Tumkur for decades. That history seeded a culture of precision engineering and tooling in the district that continues in the firms that operate here today. Buyers from this belt understand build quality. They ask about the frame grade and the weld standard. We welcome those questions.

NH 48 infrastructure corridor: Road widening, flyover construction, and logistics park development along the NH 48 Tumkur stretch creates demand for portable site offices from civil contractors who need a temporary but weatherproof workspace at each active work front.

Warehouse and logistics growth: Tumkurâ€™s position â€” 65 km from Bangaloreâ€™s outer ring road, on the main highway to Mumbai â€” has made it a target for third-party logistics operators and e-commerce fulfilment centres building large warehouse campuses. Security cabins at warehouse gates and supervisor offices inside the compound are standard requirements.

Specifications Built for Tumkur Industrial Sites

Our porta cabins are factory-built to a consistent specification using materials that match the standards expected by engineering-sector buyers. We do not build with off-cuts or variable-thickness sections. Every frame is IS 2062 grade mild steel hollow section â€” the same structural grade used in commercial building columns â€” factory-welded and documented.

  • Frame: IS 2062 MS hollow section. Factory-cut, welded, and inspected. Anti-rust primer coat applied before panels are fixed. No field welding at your site.
  • Panels: 40mm PUF sandwich panel as standard â€” polyurethane foam core bonded between two pre-painted steel skins. Thermal insulation value reduces internal temperature meaningfully. Cement fibre board available as alternative for sites needing higher impact resistance.
  • Roof: GI sheet with zinc anti-corrosion coating. Heat-reflective finish on outer surface. Tumkurâ€™s elevated plateau (823 metres above sea level) means temperatures are milder than coastal or interior cities but monsoon intensity is moderate â€” the GI roof handles both.
  • Floor: Anti-skid chequered steel sheet as standard. 18mm plywood on MS cross-member frame available for office-use cabins requiring a warmer underfoot surface. Tile floor in toilet compartments.
  • Doors: MS powder-coated door, single or double leaf, with mortise lock and door closer. Painted wooden door with steel frame available.
  • Windows: Sliding glass in aluminium section frame, MS mesh fixed vent, or jalousie louvre. Any combination across the cabin face.
  • Electrical: Single-phase wiring from cabin entry point, MCB board, wall switches, 5A and 15A sockets, LED light fittings, fan point. Specified to your declared electrical load.

Custom sizes built to your footprint. If your Hirehalli or Antharasanahalli plot has a specific space constraint, send the dimensions and we design within them.

Customisation â€” Confirmed Before Manufacturing, Permanent After

The detail that most buyers appreciate about ordering directly from a manufacturer: everything you specify happens at the factory, under quality control, before the cabin is loaded. Nothing is an afterthought bolted on at your site by a fitter who was not part of the original build.

Electrical fit-out: We wire for your specific load â€” AC unit, desktop computers, power tools, lighting. MCB board sized to match. Earth leakage circuit breaker. Wall sockets at positions you specify on the layout drawing we share before production. LED fittings recessed or surface-mounted. Fan hanging point with speed regulator socket. External floodlight point on the cabin exterior for night-shift security posts.

Air conditioner provision: Panel cut-out at the height your AC indoor unit requires. Bracket welded to the cabin outer frame for the outdoor compressor unit. Copper pipe sleeve of the correct diameter through the panel. Condensate drain pipe at floor level. Ready for your electrician to install the AC on arrival â€” no drilling, no improvisations.

False ceiling: 12mm plywood panel or 10mm PVC tongue-and-groove board on MS angle sub-frame. Reduces internal height to 7 to 7.5 feet clear, cuts the dead air volume the AC or fan has to manage, and covers the GI roof underside. For precision engineering office environments where a clean ceiling matters, this is a standard inclusion.

Toilet compartment: 4 ft Ã— 4 ft or 5 ft Ã— 4 ft wet room attached to or within the main cabin. FRP water tank (500 to 1,000 litres) mounted on roof frame. WC with cistern, wash hand basin, floor trap, soil pipe outlet at base. 4-feet tile dado inside the wet room. Plumbing connections to your site water supply and disposal point by your plumber on arrival. For labour colony or long-stay site applications, a 40 ft Ã— 8 ft cabin with 4 separate toilet cubicles is available on request.

Partition wall: Plywood or gypsum-on-stud dividing a long cabin into two rooms with separate entry doors. Useful for highway contractors needing a combined office-plus-storeroom layout in a single 20 ft Ã— 8 ft footprint.

Exterior branding: Primer coat plus two-coat gloss enamel in your colour. Company name board in enamel or printed PVC board. Reflective tape on corners for night visibility at gate security posts.

Wind and rain resistance: Tumkurâ€™s location on the Deccan plateau at 823 metres elevation means NH 48 sites can experience stronger crosswinds than lower-altitude cities. On request, we add diagonal wind-brace angles inside the roof frame for cabins placed in exposed locations â€” at no extra cost, just tell us at enquiry stage.

Our Manufacturing Credentials â€” What the Certificates Mean

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd, established 2009, incorporated 2019.

Certificate E20250218645. This certification means our manufacturing process is documented, our incoming materials are checked against specification, our weld quality is inspected, and our finished product is verified before dispatch. Not every prefab cabin manufacturer holds this. It is the document a project auditor asks for when verifying vendor qualification.

ISO 14001:2015 â€” Environmental Management Systems
Certificate E20250218646. We manage waste, paint fumes, and material disposal to certified environmental standards at our Bangalore factory.

ISO 45001:2018 â€” Occupational Health and Safety
Certificate E20250218647. Worker safety at our manufacturing facility meets internationally audited standards.

Warranty and service life:
Structural MS frame and base: 5 years.
Panel finishing, roofing, and paint: 1 to 2 years.
Engineered service life of the complete structure: 20 to 25 years under normal industrial site conditions.

More than 500 prefab steel structure projects completed since 2009 â€” site offices, security posts, labour colonies, porta cabin clusters for infrastructure contractors â€” across South India.

For engineering-sector buyers in Tumkur who need vendor documentation for an internal audit, we supply certificate copies, GST registration, and NSIC papers as part of your order file.

Delivery to Tumkur â€” The Proximity Advantage in Numbers

  • Dispatch point: Gopasandra, Sarjapura Hubli Road, Bangalore 560099
  • Route: NH 48 directly north from Bangalore to Tumkur
  • Distance: approximately 65 kilometres
  • Driving time: 1 to 1.5 hours under normal traffic
  • Transit to your Tumkur address: 1 to 2 days from dispatch

This is the shortest factory-to-city transit of any SAMAN city page in the South cluster. For buyers with urgent requirements â€” a site that is about to start and has no office yet, a security cabin needed before the factory handover inspection â€” Tumkurâ€™s proximity to our Bangalore factory is a real operational advantage.

Standard lead time from order confirmation to dispatch:

  • Standard size, no customisation: 7 to 10 working days manufacture
  • Custom fit-out (electrical, AC, partition): 10 to 15 working days
  • After dispatch: 1 to 2 days transit to Tumkur

Total from order to delivery for a standard cabin: 8 to 12 working days. For a fully fitted cabin: 11 to 17 working days.

If your requirement is genuinely urgent, call us directly rather than using the form. We assess whether a standard-size unit can be prioritised in our production queue and give you a realistic committed date â€” not an estimate.

Offloading requires a crane or telehandler at your site. A 5-tonne mobile crane handles cabins up to 20 ft Ã— 8 ft with standard fit-out. Heavier units need 7.5 tonnes. We provide exact weight in your delivery note.

Placement: a levelled hard surface is sufficient for temporary use. For permanent KIADB plot installations, we include anchor bolt fixing plates in the base frame and provide the bolt pattern drawing to your civil team.

We deliver to KIADB Hirehalli (572168), Antharasanahalli (572106), and all Tumkur city and Tumkur district addresses. Our porta cabin category and the full range of sizes and configurations are all available from this Bangalore facility.

See also nearby South India pages: porta cabin in Mysore and porta cabin in Hosur.

View our porta cabin models for detailed product specifications, photos, and enquiry options.

Pricing â€” Transparent Line-Item Quotation

No price is published here because every cabin is built to your specification and priced accordingly. What we do publish is exactly what factors determine your cost, so you know what to expect before calling.

Size: The external footprint and height. All material and labour costs scale with size. A 20 ft Ã— 10 ft costs roughly twice the material of a 10 ft Ã— 8 ft â€” the price reflects that directly.

Panel type: 40mm PUF sandwich panel is our standard. It is the most cost-effective option for the thermal performance it delivers. Cement fibre board panels are heavier, more durable for heavy-traffic applications, and carry a modest material premium.

Fit-out level: A bare cabin with one door and one window is the minimum. Every electrical point, AC provision, false ceiling, partition wall, and toilet module adds labour and material cost in proportion. There is no arbitrary mark-up on customisation items â€” we quote at actual material and labour.

Quantity: Multi-unit orders for the same site receive consolidated freight and may reduce the per-unit manufacturing cost slightly due to batch efficiencies. If you need 3 or more identical units, mention this when enquiring.

Freight: Tumkur is 65 km from our factory â€” the shortest freight distance of any Batch 6 city. Freight for a 10 ft Ã— 8 ft cabin is minimal. For a heavy 40 ft fitted unit, freight reflects the vehicle and crane requirements. Quoted as a separate line item â€” never buried in the unit price.

Send your cabin size, use, quantity, and Tumkur delivery address. Complete written quotation with full line-item breakup within 24 hours.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can you deliver a porta cabin to KIADB Hirehalli Industrial Area, Tumkur, within 2 weeks of my order?

For a standard size with no custom fit-out â€” 10 ft Ã— 8 ft or 20 ft Ã— 8 ft with a door and window only â€” manufacture takes 7 to 10 working days and transit to Hirehalli (PIN 572168) is 1 to 2 days. Total: 8 to 12 working days from order confirmation. Yes, 2 weeks is achievable for standard cabins. Custom fit-out with electrical, AC, and toilet takes 11 to 17 working days total. Tell us your deadline when you call â€” we confirm whether it is achievable honestly, not optimistically.

What base does my Tumkur site need for the cabin to sit on?

A levelled, hard, compacted surface. Compacted murrum, paver block, or existing concrete slab all work for temporary or semi-permanent placement. The cabin does not need a poured RCC foundation unless you are installing it permanently, in which case we include anchor bolt fixing plates in the base frame and provide the bolt pattern drawing. For KIADB plot installations where the cabin is part of a long-term factory setup, we recommend the anchor bolt option.

Do you supply porta cabins to warehouse and logistics sites near Tumkur on NH 48?

Yes. We supply to logistics parks, warehouse campuses, and e-commerce fulfilment centres along the NH 48 Tumkur belt. Security cabins at compound gates, supervisor offices inside the warehouse, and labour rest rooms are the standard requirements for these sites. We can supply multiple units in a coordinated dispatch if your project needs cabins at several locations.

Can we visit your factory in Bangalore before placing the order?

Yes. Our manufacturing facility is at Gopasandra, Sarjapura Hubli Road, Bangalore 560099 â€” approximately 65 km from Tumkur. You are welcome to visit and inspect a cabin in progress or a completed unit before placing your order. Call +91 88616 22859 to arrange the visit in advance so we can schedule time with our production team.

Call or Send an Enquiry

For porta cabins in Tumkur, KIADB Hirehalli, Antharasanahalli, or anywhere in Tumkur district:

+91 88616 22859 | +91 80886 85440

Call or WhatsApp. Same working day response. When using the enquiry form, include your cabin size, intended use, quantity, and Tumkur delivery address â€” we return a complete written quotation without needing a follow-up call to gather the basics.
